    page-layout: full
    toc: false
    anchor-sections: false

---

```{=html}
<!-- ── Hero ──────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
<section class="imglib-hero">
  <div class="imglib-hero-inner">
    <p class="imglib-eyebrow">Resources</p>
    <h1 class="imglib-hero-title">Image Library</h1>
    <p class="imglib-hero-lede">Screenshots and renders from OpenSpace. Click any image to view full size, use arrow keys to browse, and download directly from the viewer.</p>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ── Grid ──────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
<div class="imglib-grid-section">
  <div class="imglib-grid" id="imglibGrid"></div>
</div>

<!-- ── CTA ────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
<section class="cta-section">
  <div class="cta-card">
    <h2 class="section-heading">Using these images?</h2>
    <p class="section-lede">Images produced with OpenSpace are free to use for educational and editorial purposes. Please credit the OpenSpace Project and follow our brand guidelines.</p>
    <div class="hero-actions">
      <a class="btn-primary-os" href="../../about/brand.qmd">Brand &amp; Attribution</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ── Lightbox ──────────────────────────────────────────── -->
<div class="imglib-lb" id="imglibLb" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Image viewer" aria-hidden="true">
  <div class="imglib-lb-backdrop"></div>
  <button class="imglib-lb-close" aria-label="Close">&times;</button>
  <button class="imglib-lb-prev" aria-label="Previous image">&#8249;</button>
  <button class="imglib-lb-next" aria-label="Next image">&#8250;</button>
  <div class="imglib-lb-body">
    <div class="imglib-lb-img-wrap">
      <img class="imglib-lb-img" src="" alt="">
    </div>
    <div class="imglib-lb-footer">
      <span class="imglib-lb-title"></span>
      <span class="imglib-lb-counter"></span>
      <a class="imglib-lb-dl" href="" download aria-label="Download image">
        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/><polyline points="7 10 12 15 17 10"/><line x1="12" y1="15" x2="12" y2="3"/></svg>
        Download
      </a>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {

  var DL_SVG = '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/><polyline points="7 10 12 15 17 10"/><line x1="12" y1="15" x2="12" y2="3"/></svg>';

  var IMGS = [
    { src: '12211296_10153818406893578_1535618058_o.webp', title: 'OpenSpace Visualization' },
    { src: '2014-06-18_12-31-25_BarbaClose2.webp',         title: 'Surface Close-Up' },
    { src: '2014-06-26_15-19-27_AllPowerScale2.webp',      title: 'Power Scale' },
    { src: '2020-09+SMSU+1.webp',                          title: 'SMSU Presentation' },
    { src: '2020-09+SMSU+2.webp',                          title: 'SMSU Presentation' },
    { src: '2035-08-21+070727.webp',                       title: 'Solar System' },
    { src: 'Apollo11_LM.webp',                             title: 'Apollo 11 Lunar Module' },
    { src: 'Burma+Tibet.webp',                             title: 'Burma & Tibet from Orbit' },
    { src: 'CGmosaic.webp',                                title: 'CG Mosaic' },
    { src: 'DSC02405.webp',                                title: 'OpenSpace at Event' },
    { src: 'Earth+imersed+in+data.webp',                   title: 'Earth Immersed in Data' },
    { src: 'Ganges2.webp',                                 title: 'Ganges River' },
    { src: 'Ganges4.webp',                                 title: 'Ganges River' },
    { src: 'Good+Morning+NYC.webp',                        title: 'Good Morning NYC' },
    { src: 'Hello+NYC.webp',                               title: 'Hello NYC' },
    { src: 'IMG_3742.webp',                                title: 'OpenSpace' },
    { src: 'IMG_4619.webp',                                title: 'OpenSpace' },
    { src: 'Larsen+Ice+Shelf+breakup.webp',                title: 'Larsen Ice Shelf Breakup' },
    { src: 'Mars+Southwest+Candor+Chasma+3.webp',          title: 'Mars — Candor Chasma' },
    { src: 'Mojave.webp',                                  title: 'Mojave Desert' },
    { src: 'New+Horizons.webp',                            title: 'New Horizons' },
    { src: 'Pluto-Heart.webp',                             title: 'Pluto — Tombaugh Regio' },
    { src: 'SGCT_000026.webp',                             title: 'SGCT Visualization' },
    { src: 'SGCT_win0_000000.webp',                        title: 'SGCT Visualization' },
    { src: 'SGCT_win0_000004.webp',                        title: 'SGCT Visualization' },
    { src: 'SGCT_win0_000005.webp',                        title: 'SGCT Visualization' },
    { src: 'apollo_16.webp',                               title: 'Apollo 16' },
    { src: 'earth.webp',                                   title: 'Earth from Space' },
    { src: 'earth_atmosphere.webp',                        title: 'Earth Atmosphere' },
    { src: 'fjord.webp',                                   title: 'Norwegian Fjord' },
    { src: 'gaia.webp',                                    title: 'Gaia Star Survey' },
    { src: 'galaxy_cropped.webp',                          title: 'Galaxy' },
    { src: 'goddard-openspace-mars.webp',                  title: 'Mars at Goddard' },
    { src: 'gps_satellites.webp',                          title: 'GPS Satellite Constellation' },
    { src: 'info.webp',                                    title: 'OpenSpace Interface' },
    { src: 'mas-bastille.webp',                            title: 'Mas Bastille' },
    { src: 'moon.webp',                                    title: 'Moon' },
    { src: 'orion+nebula.webp',                            title: 'Orion Nebula' },
    { src: 'orion.webp',                                   title: 'Orion' },
    { src: 'pluto-up_map-2.webp',                          title: 'Pluto Surface Map' },
    { src: 'pluto-up_map-21.webp',                         title: 'Pluto Surface Map' },
    { src: 'pluto-up_map-36.webp',                         title: 'Pluto Surface Map' },
    { src: 'pluto-up_map-9.webp',                          title: 'Pluto Surface Map' },
    { src: 'youtube-channelart.webp',                      title: 'YouTube Channel Art' }
  ];

  // ── Build grid ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  var grid = document.getElementById('imglibGrid');
  IMGS.forEach(function (img, i) {
    var item = document.createElement('div');
    item.className = 'imglib-item';
    item.tabIndex = 0;
    item.setAttribute('role', 'button');
    item.setAttribute('aria-label', 'View ' + img.title);
    item.innerHTML =
      '<img class="imglib-thumb" src="' + img.src + '" alt="' + img.title + '" loading="lazy">' +
      '<div class="imglib-overlay">' +
        '<p class="imglib-item-title">' + img.title + '</p>' +
        '<a class="imglib-dl-btn" href="' + img.src + '" download aria-label="Download ' + img.title + '">' +
          DL_SVG +
        '</a>' +
      '</div>';

    item.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      if (e.target.closest('.imglib-dl-btn')) return;
      open(i);
    });
    item.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); open(i); }
    });

    grid.appendChild(item);
  });

  // ── Lightbox state ─────────────────────────────────────────
  var currentIdx  = 0;
  var lastFocused = null;
  var lb          = document.getElementById('imglibLb');
  var lbImg       = lb.querySelector('.imglib-lb-img');
  var lbTitle     = lb.querySelector('.imglib-lb-title');
  var lbCounter   = lb.querySelector('.imglib-lb-counter');
  var lbDl        = lb.querySelector('.imglib-lb-dl');
  var prevBtn     = lb.querySelector('.imglib-lb-prev');
  var nextBtn     = lb.querySelector('.imglib-lb-next');
  var closeBtn    = lb.querySelector('.imglib-lb-close');
  var backdrop    = lb.querySelector('.imglib-lb-backdrop');
  var imgWrap     = lb.querySelector('.imglib-lb-img-wrap');

  function show(idx) {
    if (idx < 0) idx = IMGS.length - 1;
    if (idx >= IMGS.length) idx = 0;
    currentIdx = idx;
    var d = IMGS[idx];
    lbImg.classList.add('loading');
    lbImg.onload = function () { lbImg.classList.remove('loading'); };
    lbImg.src    = d.src;
    lbImg.alt    = d.title;
    lbTitle.textContent    = d.title;
    lbCounter.textContent  = (idx + 1) + ' / ' + IMGS.length;
    lbDl.href              = d.src;
    lbDl.setAttribute('download', d.src);
  }

  function open(idx) {
    lastFocused = document.activeElement;
    show(idx);
    lb.classList.add('is-open');
    lb.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    closeBtn.focus();
  }

  function close() {
    lb.classList.remove('is-open');
    lb.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
    lbImg.src = '';
    if (lastFocused) lastFocused.focus();
  }

  // ── Controls ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  closeBtn.addEventListener('click', close);
  backdrop.addEventListener('click', close);
  prevBtn.addEventListener('click',  function () { show(currentIdx - 1); });
  nextBtn.addEventListener('click',  function () { show(currentIdx + 1); });

  // Click left/right half of image to navigate
  imgWrap.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var mid = imgWrap.getBoundingClientRect().left + imgWrap.offsetWidth / 2;
    if (e.clientX < mid) show(currentIdx - 1);
    else show(currentIdx + 1);
  });

  // Keyboard
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (!lb.classList.contains('is-open')) return;
    if (e.key === 'Escape')     { e.preventDefault(); close(); }
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft')  { e.preventDefault(); show(currentIdx - 1); }
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') { e.preventDefault(); show(currentIdx + 1); }
  });

})();
</script>
```
